federationRegions.intro: Each region runs its queries on its own engine: the store the platform assigned this organization as the region's engine, with its engine kind and connection URL.
federationRegions.readOnlyNote: The platform administrator assigns each region's engine. It is shown here read-only.
federationRegions.sandboxNote: This is shown to explain regions. It cannot be changed in a demo.
federationRegions.restartNote: A change applies when the region's nodes restart.
federationRegions.restartPending: Saved. The change applies when the region's nodes restart.
federationRegions.storeHelp: The store this region names as its engine. Which store it is is set on the Platform page.
federationRegions.sharedHint: Also the engine of {{regions}}. A change here applies there too.
federationRegions.urlHelp: The engine's connection URL, or a reference such as ${env:NAME}. It is kept exactly as entered. A password in it is never shown again; leave the URL unchanged to keep it.
federationRegions.storeMissing: Region {{region}} names {{store}} as its engine, and the organization has no store {{store}}.
